refuted.what: Usman's hindquarters are a shapeless black mass that grows into Indio's hand, the hand coming out of the dog with no arm and a clawed paw curling beside it.
refuted.why: The gesturing hand is clearly Indio's own: its wrist carries his red kerchief and connects up into his grey coat sleeve. The clawed shape at lower right is the dog's normal forepaw. Dark coat and dark dog overlap but nothing is merged or disembodied.
